# mobius 0.16.49

Memory is now a scoped wiki of linked Markdown pages with descriptions and version-checked patches. Idle consolidation reads new chat history and updates pages through the same patch path. Conflicting batches are rejected before writing, replacements precede source deletion, and middleware idle deadlines are independent.

The obsolete portable migration scripts were removed. Historical tagged release notes remain available. Existing legacy memory records are not automatically converted into pages. No compatibility migration is included.
